title: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2): second-biggest Zelda launch in UK history by physical sales, per Christopher Dring (The Game Business), NielsenIQ data
game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2)
why: First sales read on the launch week: UK physical, ranked against Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom; no unit figure.

sources.name: Christopher Dring, Substack note (The Game Business)

first_report: Dring's Substack note, 8 Nov 2026 5:42 PM (zone unstated); read in full by me 8 Nov 2026 about 20:55Z; Nintendo Everything 8 Nov, Twisted Voxel 9 Nov.
footage: Nintendo US store Overview trailer for Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 (assets.nintendo.com, 1280x720, the only official OoT Switch 2 video; Nintendo's YouTube is refused without sign-in; IGN and the Nintendo press site had no larger copy). 720p cannot fill 9:16 inside the 2x cap, so the showcase layout (CLAUDE.md 8 Nov point 5b). One stretch 186.9 to 204.6 s, speech-free by faster-whisper (words at 183.0 to 186.8 and 205.0 to 206.6 bracket it); not used in earlier Ocarina Reels.

claims.text: Dring: the UK's second biggest Zelda launch of all time (physical sales only)
First week 35% bigger than Breath of the Wild on Switch and Wii U in 2017
Roughly half of Tears of the Kingdom's first week
Comfortably the biggest physical game launch this year (so far), ahead of Resident Evil, Call of Duty, EA Sports FC
NOT claimed: any unit figure; any Nintendo statement; 'very strong start'

gate: gate 20:55Z: Dring's note read in full (WebFetch); no Nintendo primary with figures found, so chip تقرير attributed to Dring, with «لم تنشر نينتيندو أرقامًا». Exit B. The note's time zone is unstated.

angle.hook: Ocarina of Time is the UK's second-biggest Zelda launch ever on physical sales, per Christopher Dring
angle.why_now: Dring posted the first launch-week read on 8 Nov, three days after the 5 Nov Switch 2 release, using NielsenIQ UK physical data.
angle.what_it_means_here: It shows the remake selling about a third above Breath of the Wild and about half of Tears of the Kingdom in physical copies in one market; digital sales are not included, no unit figure was given, and Nintendo has not published figures.
angle.payoff: the two comparisons and the missing Nintendo figure, in the closing lines
